note: Every page of both fixtures is rastered for a human who did not build this family. It matters more than usual here: JDF 612 and JDF 615 changed revision, and a reviewer reading the paper is the check that a value sits under the heading it belongs to.
whatToLookAt: JDF 612 sections A, B, C and 2: confirm the county, case number, defendant name, birth date, mailing address, city/state/zip, phone and e-mail each sit under the heading they belong to, the court type is not chosen, and the interpreter and court-attendance questions are unanswered. On JDF 613 and JDF 614, confirm only the A–C caption is populated and every numbered court body remains blank. On JDF 615, the county and case number are populated; the caption's Defendant line is blank because it is one field with section 2(a), which the court completes.

JDF 612 section 3: every box unticked, including the Colorado Bureau of Investigation box (the July 2025 form ships it unticked though it prints "(Required)"), the court case number written beside "District or County Court", and every agency line blank.
JDF 612 section 4: the three offence-class boxes unticked, the offence lines blank, the sentencing and supervision-termination dates blank, and both yes-or-no groups unticked.
JDF 612 section 5: neither eligibility branch ticked, none of the three consent options ticked, and the explanation box blank.
JDF 612 sections 6, 7 and 8: every yes-or-no group unticked, the appeal lines blank, and the statement box blank.
JDF 612 certificate of service and signature: no service date, no method, no recipient, no signature, no date, and the counsel block blank.
JDF 615 section 3: all four court findings unticked. This is the one to look at hardest — each is a finding the court makes, and a tick there would be the packet making the judge's finding for them.

JDF 615 numbered body: birth date, address repetitions, all four court findings, agency name, case and arrest numbers, other orders, signature and date remain blank, including 2(a) Full Name; neither Judge nor Magistrate is ticked.
